run_multiplex_grpc_server: run the gRPC server that services both Greeter and RouteGuide RPCs on port 50051
review_GreeterServicer_SayHello: review the GreeterServicer SayHello method that returns a HelloReply with the user name
review_RouteGuideServicer_GetFeature: review the RouteGuideServicer GetFeature method that looks up a feature by location point
review_RouteGuideServicer_RecordRoute: review the RouteGuideServicer RecordRoute method that calculates point count, distance, and elapsed time
review_RouteGuideServicer_RouteChat: review the RouteGuideServicer RouteChat method that echoes notes matching the same location
